title: KubeCon 2026 - travel & admin scratchpad
content:
Quick scratchpad for travel/admin items — messy, will tidy later.

OVERVIEW / DATES
- KubeCon NA 2026 (Moscone Center, SF) — March 10-13, 2026
- My travel: depart 3/9 evening (SFO red-eye), return 3/14 evening
- Booth: B12 (island) — setup 3/9 afternoon, teardown 3/13 6pm

FLIGHTS / HOTELS (confirmed)
- Flight: UA 1821 // 3/9 18:45 SFO -> SFO (home leg?) <-- double-check (booking shows 3/9 22:30)
- Return: UA 1899 // 3/14 19:00 SFO -> SEA (placeholder) — confirm exact times
- Hotel: Marriott Marquis SF, reservation under Redwood Inference (Noah S.), conf rate applied
- Hotel address + phone: 780 Mission St, San Francisco, CA; (415) 896-1600

BOOTH / SHIPPING / VENDORS
- Booth vendor (build/teardown): BrightBooths
  - Contact: Maya Singh, maya@brightbooths.co, +1-415-555-0123
  - Ship arrival window: 3/8-3/9 (deliver to Moscone loading dock)
  - Tracking: FedEx 612345678901 (label created) — check pickup schedule
- AV vendor: Sound&Light Pro
  - Contact: Luis Ortega, luis@soundlightpro.com, +1-650-555-0188
  - AV plan attached in Confluence (see CONFLUENCE:KUBE-LOGISTICS-1234)
- Catering (reception): LocalEats Catering
  - Contact: Hannah Park, hannah@localeats.co, +1-415-555-0199

SHIPPING / ADDRESS (use Redwood shipping template)
- Shipping label: Redwood Inference / Attn: Noah Sullivan / Booth B12 / Moscone Center / 747 Howard St, SF, CA 94103 (use vendor instruction sheet)
- Action: confirm carrier will unload to dock, add lift gate if crate > 150 lbs

EXPENSES / REIMBURSEMENT
- Policy: upload receipts to Ramp within 30 days, code to project: events-kubecon-2026
- Per-person per-diem estimate: $60/day x 5 days = $300 (meals) — keep receipts for anything above per-diem
- Hotel: charged to company card, incidentals on personal card (save receipts)
- Booth shipping estimate: $1,250 (FedEx freight) — pre-approve w/ finance (JIRA:TRAVEL-456 has PO request)
- Misc (swag, shipping materials): estimate $2,000 — need final invoices
- TODO for finance: request one-time bump to booth budget (contact: Priya Patel, finance)

DOCUMENTS / LINKS (quick)
- Confluence: KUBE-LOGISTICS-1234 (floor plan, AV specs, vendor contracts)
- Jira: TRAVEL-456 (PO + expense approval)
- Slack: #events-kubecon (for live updates and volunteer signups)
- Meeting invites: booth-shifts-calendar (shared with team)

PACKING / CHECKLIST (rough)
- Laptop + chargers (2), USB-C hubs (2), hdmi adapters, dongles
- Demo laptops (2), extra batteries, power strips (2), surge protectors
- Swag: stickers (2 boxes), shirts (medium/large mix), pens (500)
- Marketing prints: one-sheeters (200), business cards (250)
- Tools: box cutter, gaffer tape, zip ties, labeler, extra screws
- Signage: retractable banner (x2), table runner (Redwood logo)
- PPE / misc: hand sanitizer, masks, first-aid kit

PEOPLE / SHIFTS (tentative)
- Day 1 (3/10): Noah (AM), Samantha (PM), Alex (float)
- Day 2 (3/11): Jamie (AM), Samantha (PM)
- Day 3 (3/12): Alex (AM), Noah (PM)
- Day 4 (3/13 teardown): team TBD — need volunteers for teardown crew (2 people)
- Action: confirm headcount by 2/24 and publish shift spreadsheet

VENDOR CONTACTS (quick card)
- BrightBooths — Maya Singh — maya@brightbooths.co — +1-415-555-0123 — onsite lead for setup/teardown
- Sound&Light Pro — Luis Ortega — luis@soundlightpro.com — +1-650-555-0188 — AV lead, requires final run-of-show by 2/28
- LocalEats Catering — Hannah Park — hannah@localeats.co — +1-415-555-0199 — confirm dietary restrictions by 3/1
- Freight / carrier — FedEx Freight — acct rep: Jorge Ramos — jorge.ramos@fedex.com — +1-800-123-4567

NOTES / QUESTIONS / TODOS (messy)
- Need final swag count + dimensions for shipping (who owns this? marketing?)
- Confirm booth power location and voltage with venue (AV vendor to confirm)
- Who is submitting the PO for booth build? I think product-ops (Priya) — follow up (JIRA:TRAVEL-456)
- Confirm whether Redwood badge scan list needed for VIPs — slack #events-kubecon to check
- Expense reminders: send team note on 3/16 to upload receipts (30-day reminder) + template for coding expenses (events-kubecon-2026)
- Check if we can get early load-in on 3/8 evening — if yes, adjust hotel nights

QUICK ACTIONS (this week)
- [ ] Confirm final booth headcount and shift schedule (owner: Noah) — due 2026-02-24
- [ ] Send vendor final run-of-show to AV and booth vendor (owner: Alex) — due 2026-02-28
- [ ] Request finance pre-approval for shipping + swag (owner: Noah, contact Priya) — due 2026-02-20 (pinged)
- [ ] Create Ramp expense template + upload instructions for team (owner: Samantha) — due 2026-02-22
- [ ] Confirm dietary restrictions with catering (owner: Jamie) — due 2026-03-01

RANDOM NOTES / TO SELF
- Might request an extra folding table for demos — check booth layout (confluence).
- Keep one demo laptop signed into staging only — do not use prod credentials on demo machines.
- If shipping crates are delayed, call FedEx acct rep Jorge ASAP (see contact above).

END — will clean up and move finalized items to Confluence / Jira as things lock in.
